parts.text: You are provided with two solids: solid E and solid F. Do the following tests on solid E and solid F. Record all of your observations at each stage. Tests on solid E Add about 3 cm depth of distilled water to the boiling tube containing solid E. Replace the stopper in the boiling tube and shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid E and form solution E. Divide solution E into three approximately equal portions in one boiling tube and two test-tubes.

parts.text: (f) Add about 3 cm depth of distilled water to the remaining solid F in the boiling tube. Replace the stopper in the boiling tube and shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid F and form solution F. Divide solution F into three approximately equal portions in two boiling tubes and one test-tube.
